audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read Skill on both layers while mid says 'this matchup swings decisively in your favour' at 6; 2+ items read Riven while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say to stop hunting solo kills. Packet chart: Riven, Riven, Skill.
audit.why: 55.01% over 2643 games — Riven's strongest stretch is levels 3-6 and the chart hid it, while overstating the two-item stage.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 -> Riven, Level 6 -> Riven, 2+ items -> Skill, as three matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present and ordered: Lvl 2-3 W stun, Lvl 6 Blade of the Exile, 1st item Shieldbow, 2+ items Yone.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0] both describe Soul Unbound as a heal — 'safety-rewind his way to full HP' and 'the rewind brings him back to high HP while you carry all the damage'. Riot's text says the spirit leaves his body, gains move speed, and on ending repeats a portion of the damage he dealt. There is no healing. spikes[1] and mid also call Wind Slash an execute delivering 'a full HP bar's worth' in a 'cone'.
audit.why: A player told the rewind heals him will refuse winnable all-ins during Soul Unbound — exactly the window the rest of the page correctly tells them to punish. The two claims contradict each other on the same page.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound (22/19/16/13/10s): spirit walk, move speed, repeats a portion of the damage he dealt on return — no heal, and the body is where he reappears. Wind Slash is one ranged projectile per R (120/90/60s), not an execute or a cone.

audit.why: Soul Unbound is correctly the tracked cooldown and the snap-back is correctly the punish point; its 10-22s range is now stated in spikes[1].

edits.before: Land W stun before Soul Unbound is active so he cannot dash out and safety-rewind his way to full HP
edits.after: Land W stun before Soul Unbound is active so he cannot walk the spirit out and repeat its damage

edits.before: Activate Soul Unbound early in trades so the rewind brings him back to high HP while you carry all the damage
edits.after: Activate Soul Unbound early so the spirit repeats a chunk of its damage when it snaps back into his body

edits.before: Blade of the Exile extends your melee range and the Wind Slash execute punishes Yone the moment Soul Unbound forces him to snap back to his body — he cannot E-rewind away and eat a full HP bar's worth of execute damage.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile extends your melee range and Wind Slash, your one ranged shot, punishes Yone the exact moment Soul Unbound (10-22s) forces him back into his body — that return point is fixed and he cannot cancel it.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are about maintaining the lead from the Level 3 all-in without letting him reset the lane. Keep the wave frozen near your tower to force him into your threat range whenever he last-hits; his Q dash chain is strong but directionally predictable — dodge Q3 with your own Q-dash sideways and respond with W while he is in animation. At Level 6 this matchup swings decisively in your favour: Blade of the Exile gives you the range to W-stun him even as he tries to back off and your Wind Slash punishes the exact moment Soul Unbound snaps him back to his body, hitting him at partial HP with a full execute cone. Never throw R second cast while he still has Soul Unbound tether active — wait for the rewind, then release Wind Slash as he materialises.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are about maintaining the lead from the Level 3 all-in without letting him reset the lane. Keep the wave frozen near your tower to force him into your threat range whenever he last-hits; his Q dash chain is strong but directionally predictable — dodge the 2-stack Mortal Steel knockup with your own Q-dash sideways and respond with W while he is still in animation. At Level 6 this matchup swings decisively in your favour: Blade of the Exile gives you the range to W-stun him even as he tries to back off, and Wind Slash punishes the exact moment Soul Unbound snaps him back into his body. Never fire Wind Slash while his spirit is still out — the body is what matters, so wait for the return and release your one shot as he materialises.
